title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total actual positives. Think about how many true positives Model C predicts and how many actual positives there are.

title: Identify True Positives
text: For Model C, a prediction is positive if the predicted probability is greater than or equal to $$0.75$$. Look at the observations and identify which ones meet this criterion and have a true label of $$1$$.

title: Count Actual Positives
text: Count how many observations have a true label of $$1$$. This will be the denominator in your recall calculation.

title: Calculate Recall
text: Using the information from the previous hints, calculate the recall for Model C.
